author: metr3570
quote: This new entry in the Onimusha series set out to make a bold comeback, but instead delivered a mediocre and uninteresting story, derivative and clichéd characters, and a dull samurai game revolving around fighting tedious monsters rather than human enemies, seemingly in an attempt to tone down the brutality.Ultimately, its lack of boldness and creativity made it difficult to give the game a favorable assessment.

author: metr3570
quote:
Nobody wants this kind of poorly written, tedious narrative, which feels like a politically correct fantasy novel shaped by a particular ideological agenda. Players are forced into the role of a male protagonist whose purpose seems to be catering to a female audience's expectations and pursuing a romance with an overbearing, physically imposing female protagonist.

The entire experience revolves around accommodating a female character, constantly tiptoeing around her feelings, and conforming to her demands at the expense of player freedom. Rather than allowing players to shape their own experience, the game reduces the male protagonist to little more than a compliant romantic counterpart to Lucia, a character whose eccentric, domineering personality and lack of romantic appeal make her difficult to sympathize with. Her expectations of the male protagonist only make the dynamic more frustrating.

GTA 6 risks tarnishing the legacy that the franchise has built over the years. No amount of money spent on production, presentation, or marketing can compensate for a fundamentally unappealing creative vision. A beautifully packaged product is still worthless if there is nothing of substance beneath the surface.

author: metr3570
quote: The appealing and distinctive characters, gameplay that strikes an excellent balance between accessibility and depth, diverse and highly flexible mecha customization, and an engaging storyline with outstanding presentation all contribute to making this game an exceptional experience. However, its somewhat limited content and a degree of incompleteness in its overall polish hold it back from truly deserving the title of a masterpiece.
game_title: Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon

author: metr3570
quote: The graphics, the scale of the game, and the grounded, realistic martial arts and action are certainly impressive. However, the game feels like a shallow patchwork of ideas copied from other titles, the story is terrible, and the gameplay is riddled with frustrating design flaws. Even the quest design feels less like something made for players and more like something built for the developers’ convenience. Technically, it is impressive, but artistically, it is a failure.

author: metr3570
quote: You can feel the director’s philosophy that games are a form of total art. It is a masterpiece that combines aesthetically stunning character and environmental design, a story ahead of its time that resonates with today’s age of AI and humanoids, smooth animation and artistic movement, seamless and intuitive gameplay, and breathtaking music that sends chills down your spine.
game_title: NieR: Automata - The End of YoRHa Edition

author: metr3570
quote: Setting the game in Japan gives it a unique touch, but aside from that, it feels too similar to the previous titles and doesn’t really offer anything new.

author: metr3570
quote: It has a good overall presentation and gameplay, but the depth and detail of the content are terrible.

author: metr3570
quote: It would have been better as a turn-based game. The game has soothing music, a calm and melancholic atmosphere, and an artistically impressive style, but developing it as an action game does not fit the overall mood.
game_title: ENDER LILIES: Quietus of the Knights

author: metr3570
quote: It’s a work where the director’s vision comes through strongly in the characters, art, graphics, and overall setting, but from a gameplay perspective, it feels significantly lacking. The controls are clunky, and compared to its apparent inspiration, NieR: Automata, the animations feel far less fluid.

author: metr3570
quote: The game itself is decent, but the Nintendo Switch port is terrible. When your inventory is full, you have to discard existing items to pick up new ones, and the option settings that are supposed to fix this only make the controls feel clunky. In TV mode, the interface is poorly optimized, causing parts of the UI to appear cut off or even completely invisible on the screen. There are several other issues as well, but the developers don’t seem to be making any effort to fix them.

author: metr3570
quote: The fact that this pretentious piece — something too embarrassing to even call a game — receives high scores from critics symbolically demonstrates the corruption of modern game critics.

author: metr3570
quote: Pragmata is an excellent shooter-adventure game. It features strong action, impressive graphics, and well-crafted gameplay elements, while its map design and characters also carry clear aesthetic value.  Setting aside some minor awkwardness in the animations and dialogue, this is shaping up to be one of the must-play games of 2026.

author: metr3570
quote: Battlefield 6 is a smooth shooter with solid controls and a polished, frustration-free gameplay experience. However, compared to its predecessors, its level of detail and overall scale have declined, and the in-game monetization model and challenges can leave players feeling dissatisfied.
